features.name: Multiple report layouts
features.description: Business Central supports various report layout options including Word, Excel, RDL, and built-in financial reports for different reporting needs.

features.name: Analysis views on list pages
features.description: Built-in analysis functionality on list pages that allows users to create aggregated views and drill-down analysis, enabling end users to create analyses themselves without Power BI.
caveats: requires explanation to end users on how to use
can only have one favorite feature by definition

features.name: RDLC reports and layouts
features.description: RDLC reports provide precise page positioning for document printing and support conditional formatting and expressions, but are outdated technology with no official support since 2016 and are being phased out.

features.name: PowerBI integration and reporting
features.description: PowerBI has become a major reporting capability in Business Central, allowing users to build data models, embed reports and dashboards directly within the client, and create interactive visualizations.
caveats: data is snapshot at time of refresh

features.name: PowerBI Data Modeling
features.description: The ability to build data models in PowerBI by importing data from Business Central tables and other data sources, which can then be shared and connected to by other tools including Excel.
caveats: data is snapshot at time of refresh

features.name: Query APIs for PowerBI
features.description: Query objects that can pre-aggregate data and be used by PowerBI to fetch data from Business Central, also discoverable and openable in analysis mode directly from the Business Central client.
caveats: speaker expresses preference for query APIs over page APIs

features.name: PowerBI Embedded in Business Central
features.description: The ability to embed PowerBI views, reports, dashboards, and scorecards directly within the Business Central client to give users dashboard capability and data manipulation access.

features.name: PowerBI Multi-System Data Integration
features.description: Capability to connect PowerBI data models to multiple systems including Business Central and external systems, combine their data, and create visualizations across all data sources.
caveats: requires appropriate connectors for external systems

features.name: PowerBI Dashboards
features.description: A collection of visuals from one or multiple PowerBI reports that provides a helicopter view on data, clickable to navigate to source report pages, refreshable on schedule.
caveats: shows current data at time of refresh

features.name: PowerBI Scorecards
features.description: Capability to take snapshots of metrics and KPIs on a schedule, track them over time, and visualize their evolution with charts or conditional formatting to show if on or below target.
caveats: useful for vendor and customer scorecards

features.name: Scorecards with conditional formatting
features.description: Scorecards allow visualization of current and historical data with conditional formatting to show whether metrics are on target or below target, embeddable back into Business Central.

features.name: PowerBI snapshots for tracking over time
features.description: Using PowerBI and snapshots to track vendor and customer scorecard information over time outside of historical Business Central documents, enabling tracking of transactional data.

features.name: Excel Co-pilot
features.description: Ability to export data from analysis mode to Excel and use Excel co-pilot to generate additional components and analysis for reporting purposes.

features.name: Report Object with Multiple Layouts
features.description: Business Central reports that support RDLC, Word, and Excel layouts for document-style output such as sales invoices, sales orders, and packing slips.

features.name: Word report layouts
features.description: Word layouts were introduced as an easier alternative to RDLC for users to create report layouts. A Word Central addin is being developed to add functionality like conditional visibility and blank zero capabilities that were available in RDLC.
caveats: currently more difficult for conditional formatting and visibility
functionality still being added to addin

features.name: Excel report layouts
features.description: Excel layouts are used for reports that summarize data and need to be analyzed further, as an alternative to RDLC and Word layouts. Out-of-box reports now include Excel layouts alongside Word layouts.

features.name: Word Central addin for report layouts
features.description: Microsoft is developing a Word Central addin that adds functionality to Word layouts, including blank zero capability and eventually conditional visibility and conditional formatting to match RDLC capabilities.

features.name: RDLC phase-out for standard reports
features.description: Microsoft is phasing out RDLC layouts in Business Central, moving standard out-of-box reports to Word or Excel layouts starting in version 27 and continuing through version 28. RDLC will be retained only for reports where it is difficult to replace, such as US check reports.
caveats: US check reports will likely remain RDLC
some legacy reports may retain RDLC
